US-Iran Talks Conclude Amid Tensions, Progress Reported

High-level talks between the United States and Iran concluded in Switzerland, with mediators reporting agreement on a roadmap for a final deal within 60 days. The negotiations, aimed at resolving long-standing issues and ending regional conflict, were reportedly impacted by U.S. President Trump's threats. Despite these tensions, both sides indicated progress, though Iran also reportedly closed the Strait of Hormuz.
